description: Sidecar of cure_pack (statement-face rewrites) for comment-domain-only sweeps: nested-comment-and-string-aware state machine, comment-domain flag-word exchange, and data-driven leading-header replacement. Code lines are never touched; every application asserts code-line equality mechanically (the comment-strip projection of the file must be byte-identical before and after).
trigger: comment-domain occurrences of flag words after the first code character (gate4 comment-guard review findings); optional leading-header replacement keyed by file basename via --header-map
idempotence: code-strip projection byte-equal across applications; second application changes nothing
flag_word_note: Exchange applies only inside comment spans and only after the first code character (leading-header region is owned by the header replacement step). Context-biaised review words exchange to their neutral English term; occurrences inside string literals or code positions are never touched.

header_spec.note: Leading comment region is replaced wholesale from --header-map data (per-file authored five-field English form, dotted field names, header end line within max_end_line). The pack ships the shape spec and validates it; header CONTENT is per-file data, never synthesized.
